item.title: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO
item.description:
Subscribe here: Apple Podcasts | Spotify | YouTube | Overcast | Pocket Casts Just like that, Jensen Huang is back on top. Reportedly, President Trump called Nvidia’s board and encouraged it to reinstate the former CEO, who had been pushed out only two weeks earlier. The board made the “correct and proper decision,” Trump wrote on Truth Social, which ensures the “Success and Prosperity of not only the Company, but the American Economy.” The president seemed happy. Tech leaders were relieved. The stock market seemed to rally with the news. A lot of other interested parties, however, still have burning questions. Lawmakers from both parties are planning to grill Huang about the affair he had with a suspected Chinese spy and the related threats to national security. But how will Americans, who just voted resoundingly against AI, data centers, and grift among the rich, receive the president…

item.title: What's driving up the cost of Thanksgiving dinner
item.description:
A group of friends celebrate the Thanksgiving Holiday with a "Friendsgiving" dinner. —Stock photo—Getty Images The American Farm Bureau Federation (AFBF) estimates that the cost of Thanksgiving dinner this year will be up more than 6% compared to last year, with steep turkey prices and higher fuel costs driving up the bill. The average 10-person dinner will cost $58.63, compared to $55.18 in 2025, according to the bureau’s annual report . This is the first year the bureau has reported a rise in the cost of the dinner since 2022, when prices hit a record high of $64.05. The agricultural organization’s estimates are based on hundreds of volunteer shoppers from all 50 states and Puerto Rico reporting prices for a standard list of items at their local grocery store. Thanksgiving dinners in the Northeast are set to be the most expensive, while dinners in the South will again be the least…

Pelicot, 73, became a global icon in the fight against sexual violence in 2024 during the trial that saw her former husband convicted of drugging and raping her , as well as recruiting 49 other men to rape her while unconscious.
